parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required when you authenticate with an Alibaba Cloud access key (AK/SK) or Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: includePersonal
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include personal private groups in the results.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description:
The field to sort the results by. The default is `updated_at`.

- `updated_at`: Sorts by update time.

- `created_at`: Sorts by creation time.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can find this ID in your organization's URL on the Alibaba Cloud DevOps platform, for example: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number. The default is `1`.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The page size. The value must be between 1 and 100. The default is `20`.

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description:
The ID of the parent namespace.

- To list all groups in the organization, set this parameter to the namespace ID of the organization (not the `organizationId`).

- To list all subgroups within a specific group, set this parameter to the namespace ID of that group.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
The sort order. The default is `desc`.

- `desc`: Descending

- `asc`: Ascending
